positions.title: Contract Programmer
positions.description: Gathered data and wrote macros to develop a MS Map Point system—a circulation and market penetration visual guide used by the circulation department to create sales and marketing strategy.

positions.title: Executive Chef
positions.description:
► Maintained monthly P&L and budget review, cost controls, purveyor relationships, weekly inventory, staffing, scheduling, training and development. 

► Documented and analyzed sales trends to develop forecasts and par levels. 

► Developed system controls of standardized scheduling, purchasing, and inventory controls.

positions.title: Head Corporate Culinary Training Coordinator/Exec Chef
positions.description:
► Part of opening restaurants worldwide. 

► Deployed advanced restaurant information technology systems for global culinary cost management.

► Lead culinary representative for new restaurant locations and grand opening events. 

► Documented food and equipment product specifications. 

► Worked on the recipe and culinary staff manuals. 

► Drafted culinary job descriptions. 

► Developed opening procedures and culinary training for several restaurants concepts, national cost control, and R&D.
